Writes an Arsenal summary table to a Word document

Source: R/arsenal_tables_write.R
mysterycall_write_arsenal_table.Rd

Writes an Arsenal summary table to a Word document

Usage

mysterycall_write_arsenal_table(object, filename, output_dir = NULL)

Arguments

object

A data frame (e.g. the output of arsenal::summary.tableby()) to write. Must be a data frame – the function will error otherwise.

filename

The filename without extension for the Word document.

output_dir

Directory where the Word document should be written. Defaults to a session-specific folder inside tempdir().

Value

Invisibly returns NULL. Called for the side effect of writing <filename>.docx to output_dir.

See also

mysterycall_write_table_pdf(), mysterycall_table_overall()

Other table: .t1_cat_pvalue(), .t1_cont_pvalue(), .t1_fmt_mean_sd(), .t1_fmt_median_iqr(), .t1_fmt_pct(), .t1_fmt_pval(), .t1_rows_categorical(), .t1_rows_continuous(), mysterycall_table1(), mysterycall_table1_gtsummary(), mysterycall_table_overall(), mysterycall_write_table_pdf(), print.mysterycall_table1()

Examples

if (FALSE) { # interactive()
mysterycall_write_arsenal_table(my_table, "output_table")
}
